text_block_list.text: Narita Brian has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.
Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.
And today, she's still—
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How's our next race, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see. Good. I'm looking forward to what's to come.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What a great race, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I was cheering with all my might. But in the next race…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Not so fast! It's gonna be a one-on-one with me! And I'm gonna come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: W-wow! What a great lineup! Hurry, get the camera!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Brian! Who are you racing next?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I guess this is what it means to be a victim of your own success.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Whatever. I don't care who's next. I'll take on anyone.
Well then…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Might I have the privilege of competing against you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about it, Brian? Do you accept my challenge?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Is it okay with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Hurry and call the editorial department! We've got more interesting news regarding Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Brian! We'd love to hear about your future goals!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Haha.
As always, she's the center of excitement.
